decisions: The source span role control has a 16px square and14px indicator. Explicit caller field layout owns8px label spacing; this wrapper is not falsely attributed to upstream. Checked/mixed/disabled/error reflect actual native/ARIA/data attributes. No separate native mixed specimen is present in the pinned page; mixed is supported by the React API. Mixed state retains checked=false as separate authority; a deliberately chosen half-indicator-width CSS minus replaces the source check glyph for the source-supported indeterminate presentation, without changing the native event/value contract.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
